plugins.name: rn
plugins.description: rn makes what you ask for, such as a document, code, or a plugin, so that the people it's for can use it for what they're after, and asks you only the points that are yours.

plugins.name: overnight
plugins.description: overnight runs rn's works as a night's batch in its own process, resumes each work that stops at the usage limit from where it stopped, and keeps a record of what stopped and what resumed for the morning.
